summary: Trashigang district is overwhelmingly forested, with 1,769.30 km² (80.3 %) of its area covered by forests. The remaining land is largely natural vegetation and high‑altitude ecosystems: alpine scrubs (126.66 km², 5.7 %), shrubs (112.43 km², 5.1 %), and meadows (99.66 km², 4.5 %). Agricultural and built‑up uses are minimal, comprising only 69.20 km² (3.1 %) and 7.32 km² (0.3 %) respectively.
